description: Page numbers under a long list or table. The current page uses the light-green pill of the active navigation item.
tip: This component is only the look: work out which page numbers to show yourself, and give each link its page URL (e.g. ?page=2).

simple.title: Simple
simple.description: Only Previous/Next with a page label. On the first page, Previous is disabled with aria-disabled.

parts.root: nav element with the aria-label "Navigasi halaman".
parts.link: A page number. Mark the current page with isActive.
parts.previous: Link to the previous page. On phones only the arrow shows.

props.isActive: Marks the page that is open (aria-current="page").
